name: SIDE CRUNCHES RIGHT
introduce:
Lie on your left side with your left foot behind your right foot. 

Put your right hand behind your head and your left hand on the right side of your oblique muscles. 

Lift your left shoulder up off the floor. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please contract your obliques during each rep.
Exhale as you raise up, and inhale as you lower down.
This exercise targets your oblique muscles.
